title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Mega Kangaskhan MEGA 080/063 SR Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Mega Kangaskhan ex SR 080/063 Mega Symphonia M1S Pokemon Card from Japan is a rare and highly sought after collectible card game item. This card features the powerful character Mega Kangaskhan in full art design, perfect for fans and collectors of Pokémon TCG. Manufactured by Nintendo in 2025, this colorless Pokémon card is part of the MEGA set and is sure to be a valuable addition to any collection. With its unique attributes and speciality as an EX card, this Japanese card is a must-have for any Pokémon card enthusiast.
